newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ahold customer fund tops 500 mln guilders.
newsitem.headline: Ahold customer fund tops 500 mln guilders.

text.p: Supermarkets group Ahold NV said on Wednesday its Ahold Dutch Customer Fund had topped 500 million guilders ($250 million).

"The 90,000 customers of leading Dutch supermarket chain Albert Heijn, saw their combined investment in the supermarket company through the Ahold Dutch Customer Fund exceed the $250 million level (500 million guilders)," Ahold said.

"This total is all the more spectacular, as it has mostly resulted from the purchases of 10 (guilder) cent investment stamps by customers for each Dutch guilder spent when shopping at one of the AH supermarkets across the country," it said.
"Each day, half of the Fund's total capital is invested in Ahold shares and the other half is lent to Royal Ahold," it said.
